scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleaned .next build cache');"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('node_modules/.cache', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleaned all caches');"
